[Source page 1]

    NYE HORISONTER

  Vestegnen is growing, and we are facing the next chapter of our
       shared history. What does it look like when we turn the page?

     In Vestegnen's Culture Week 2022 we look with art, culture and
 each other into the crystal ball and the future. The world is undergoing change,
 globally and locally, and we look toward new horizons, new faces and new
    friendships. What new tones, images and stories await us?

[Source page 10]

NEW HORIZONS:
What is the culture of the future in Vestegnen?


• What if…
    • …culture had no house but was property-less?
    • …culture was only expressed digitally?
    • …culture was only experienced alone?
    • …culture only takes place in the dark?
    • …culture unfolds in a society where everyone is a teenager?
    • …culture may not emit CO2?
    • …culture…?

               Explore the above and other (preferably extreme!) what-ifs when in your groups you talk
              about which cultural experiences Vestegnen offers circa 2050 – and what taste of
              them one can experience during the culture week 2022!
